description: Defines interfaces and classes for managing executors in the CU-UP component of a 5G network, including UE-specific and CU-UP-wide executor mappers, and configuration structures for strand-based executor setups.

classes.name: ue_executor_mapper
classes.description: Interface for accessing executors related to a specific UE in the CU-UP.

classes.name: cu_up_executor_mapper
classes.description: Interface for accessing various CU-UP-wide executors.

classes.name: strand_based_executor_config
classes.description: Configuration structure for strand-based executor setup in CU-UP.

methods.name: create_ue_executor_mapper
methods.description: Creates a UE-specific executor mapper instance.

methods.name: make_cu_up_executor_mapper
methods.description: Factory function to create a CU-UP executor mapper based on strand configuration.
